related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「每個環向場線圈的匝數」與「高溫超導電流引線」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Turns in each toroidal field coil" and "High-temperature superconducting current leads" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦史上最大的超導磁體系統：環向場線圈匝數、鈮三錫線材、中央螺管伏秒與現場繞製的極向場線圈；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程則以國際熱核融合實驗堆的定量檢核：真空室扇段、七方實物貢獻、分階段運轉與破裂緩解為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the largest superconducting magnet system ever built: toroidal field turns, niobium-tin strand, central solenoid volt-seconds and poloidal field coils wound on site; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centres on quantitative checks of ITER: vacuum-vessel sectors, in-kind contributions of seven members, staged operation and disruption mitigation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「磁壓與比壓」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「中央螺管的磁通變化」的模型移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「三乘積與點火條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Flux swing of the central solenoid" to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Triple product and the ignition condition", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「每個環向場線圈的匝數」與「高溫超導電流引線」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Turns in each toroidal field coil" and "High-temperature superconducting current leads" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.

related.title: ITER 低溫廠與氦冷凍系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「每個環向場線圈的匝數」與「高溫超導電流引線」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 低溫廠與氦冷凍系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Turns in each toroidal field coil" and "High-temperature superconducting current leads" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER Cryoplant and Helium Refrigeration must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦史上最大的超導磁體系統：環向場線圈匝數、鈮三錫線材、中央螺管伏秒與現場繞製的極向場線圈；ITER 低溫廠與氦冷凍系統則以世界最大的集中式氦冷凍廠：兩級溫度、氦存量、壓縮功、降溫能量與缺氧防護為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the largest superconducting magnet system ever built: toroidal field turns, niobium-tin strand, central solenoid volt-seconds and poloidal field coils wound on site; ITER Cryoplant and Helium Refrigeration centres on the world's largest centralised helium refrigeration plant: two temperature levels, helium inventory, compression work, cool-down energy and protection against oxygen deficiency, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「磁壓與比壓」與「低溫冷凍的電力代價」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「中央螺管的磁通變化」的模型移到ITER 低溫廠與氦冷凍系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「一萬噸冷質量的降溫」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Magnetic pressure and beta" and "The electrical cost of cryogenic cooling".
Move the model of "Flux swing of the central solenoid" to ITER Cryoplant and Helium Refrigeration, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Cooling down ten thousand tonnes of cold mass", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「每個環向場線圈的匝數」與「高溫超導電流引線」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 低溫廠與氦冷凍系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Turns in each toroidal field coil" and "High-temperature superconducting current leads" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER Cryoplant and Helium Refrigeration must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管
history.titleEn: ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid
history.text: 2008 年導體線材開始量產；2020 年首個環向場線圈運抵工地；2021 年首個中央螺管模組運抵工地；2023 年18 個環向場線圈全數交付。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2008: Series production of conductor strand began. 2020: The first toroidal field coil arrived on site. 2021: The first central solenoid module arrived on site. 2023: All 18 toroidal field coils had been delivered. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
